[Rakuten Medical](https://rakuten-med.com/us/) is a global biotechnology company that develops precision, cell-targeting cancer therapies using a proprietary technology platform called [Alluminox](https://rakuten-med.com/us/alluminox/) (photoimmunotherapy). The treatment combines a specialized drug (an antibody-dye conjugate) that binds to cancer cells with a medical laser device to selectively rupture and kill cancer cells without harming surrounding healthy tissue. [](https://rakuten-med.com/us/alluminox/)

- **Alluminox Platform:** Combines targeted antibody-dye drugs with localized, non-thermal red light illumination to trigger rapid necrosis in cancer cells. [](https://rakuten-med.com/us/alluminox/)

- **Head and Neck Cancer Treatment:** Their lead product candidate (ASP-1929, marketed as Akalux in Japan) received conditional approval in Japan in 2020/2021 to treat unresectable or recurrent head and neck cancer. [](https://bigs.bio.org/program/rakuten-medical)

- **Global Clinical Trials:** Actively conducting international Phase 3 clinical trials and testing combination therapies with immune checkpoint inhibitors (anti-PD-1 therapy) for other solid tumors. [](https://bigs.bio.org/program/rakuten-medical)

Rakuten Medical
does not make consumer or clinical remote monitoring hardware
like continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, wearable ECGs, or sleep trackers. The company is a biotechnology firm focused on developing precision cell-targeting photoimmunotherapy (the Alluminox platform) to treat cancer, rather than a digital health or wearable device manufacturer.

Standard Remote Monitoring Devices
If you are looking for actual remote patient monitoring (RPM) tools or wearables, those are provided by medical device companies and tech brands:
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Brands like Abbott (FreeStyle Libre) and Dexcom.
Smartwatches & Wearable ECGs:
Brands like Apple, Fitbit, and Garmin with FDA-cleared heart rhythm and O2 tracking.
Sleep & Vital Trackers:
Specialized clinical or consumer grade patches and rings (e.g., Oura, Masimo).
